title: Univest Corp of Pennsylvania Lowers Stake in Apple Inc. (AAPL)

organizations.name: univest corp of pennsylvania lowers stake in apple inc.

text:
Univest Corp of Pennsylvania decreased its stake in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 4.6% in the 2nd quarter, according to its most recent Form 13F filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The institutional investor owned 31,811 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 1,534 shares during the period. Apple makes up about 2.4% of Univest Corp of Pennsylvania’s investment portfolio, making the stock its 5th largest holding. Univest Corp of Pennsylvania’s holdings in Apple were worth $5,889,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission.
Other hedge funds also recently modified their holdings of the company. B. Riley Financial Inc. increased its position in shares of Apple by 27.6% during the first quarter. B. Riley Financial Inc. now owns 17,412 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $2,921,000 after acquiring an additional 3,770 shares in the last quarter. Roof Advisory Group Inc. increased its position in shares of Apple by 44.0% during the first quarter. Roof Advisory Group Inc. now owns 42,322 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $7,101,000 after acquiring an additional 12,930 shares in the last quarter. Mizuho Securities USA LLC bought a new stake in shares of Apple during the first quarter worth $1,477,000. Viridian Ria LLC bought a new stake in shares of Apple during the first quarter worth $525,000. Finally, Turim 21 Investimentos Ltda. increased its position in shares of Apple by 5.1% during the first quarter. Turim 21 Investimentos Ltda. now owns 59,421 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $9,970,000 after acquiring an additional 2,906 shares in the last quarter. 58.58% of the stock is owned by institutional investors. Shares of AAPL stock opened at $223.77 on Tuesday. The firm has a market capitalization of $1,109.54 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 24.30, a PEG ratio of 1.99 and a beta of 1.36. The company has a quick ratio of 1.24, a current ratio of 1.31 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84. Apple Inc. has a one year low of $150.24 and a one year high of $233.47.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its quarterly earnings results on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 EPS for the quarter, beating analysts’ consensus estimates of $2.18 by $0.16. The firm had revenue of $53.27 billion during the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $52.43 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.98% and a return on equity of 43.50%. The company’s revenue for the quarter was up 17.3% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same quarter last year, the company posted $1.67 earnings per share. As a group, equities research analysts predict that Apple Inc. will post 11.76 earnings per share for the current fiscal year.
Several brokerages have recently issued reports on AAPL. Atlantic Securities reissued a “neutral” rating and set a $205.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, August 1st. UBS Group set a $250.00 price objective on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research report on Monday. BMO Capital Markets increased their target price on shares of Apple from $184.00 to $199.00 and gave the stock a “market perform” rating in a report on Wednesday, August 1st. They noted that the move was a valuation call. Wells Fargo & Co set a $210.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “neutral” rating in a report on Monday, October 1st. Finally, Cleveland Research restated a “buy” rating on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, September 26th. Two research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, nineteen have assigned a hold rating and thirty have issued a buy rating to the stock. Apple has an average rating of “Buy” and a consensus target price of $221.63.
In other Apple news, COO Jeffrey E. Williams sold 61,998 shares of the stock in a transaction on Wednesday, October 3rd. The shares were sold at an average price of $232.33, for a total value of $14,403,995.34. Following the completion of the sale, the chief operating officer now owns 124,695 shares in the company, valued at $28,970,389.35. The sale was disclosed in a filing with the SEC, which is accessible through this hyperlink . Also, SVP Angela J. Ahrendts sold 25,000 shares of the stock in a transaction on Wednesday, October 3rd. The shares were sold at an average price of $232.66, for a total transaction of $5,816,500.00. Following the completion of the sale, the senior vice president now owns 105,538 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $24,554,471.08. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . In the last quarter, insiders sold 564,185 shares of company stock valued at $124,444,213. Corporate insiders own 0.06% of the company’s stock.
Apple Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
